I read the whole file and checked its new definitions against Mathlib. The definitions are `tensorObj`, `tensorObjPreadditiveCoyonedaObjAdjunction` and `GabrielPopescuAux.d`.

- `tensorObj G` is a named abbreviation for `(preadditiveCoyonedaObj G).leftAdjoint`. It is a documented specialisation and is used throughout the file. A grep of Mathlib/CategoryTheory/Abelian and Preadditive/Yoneda found no other tensor-with-G functor from `ModuleCat (End G)ᵐᵒᵖ`.
- The adjunction is built with `Adjunction.ofIsRightAdjoint`, so it is not a competing concept.
- `d` is a thin wrapper around `Sigma.desc`. It has the specific `∐ M → A` shape that the lemmas need, so it is not an independent version of an existing concept.
- The instance and theorems build on existing Mathlib notions (`IsSeparator`, `Injective`, `PreservesInjectiveObjects`, `PreservesHomology`) and do not redefine them.

I found no competing definition and no cost that would justify consolidation. My only uncertainty is that I did not search all of Mathlib for an unrelated tensor-like construction.
